title: add onboard chronicle and compat assertion harness
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduce an onboarding chronicle that emits per-model ephemeral patchnotes and a deterministic compat-assertion harness. Adds a small CLI helper to generate human-readable patchnotes (chronicle) and a gated check that fails onboarding if compatibility regressions exceed the configured tolerance. Backwards compatible with existing profile formats.
commits: c1a3f8a: introduce onboard chronicle core + chronicle serializer
b9d2e4f: add compat assertion harness and deterministic prompt set (12 cases)
f47b11d: add CLI glue (registry-cli patchnote) and manifest hook
d2a9ff0: unit tests for assertions + integration workflow update
e8c3c04: docs and release template + small perf tweak to profile ingest
description:
Motivation: teams onboarding models need concise, per-version patchnotes and an automated compatibility check that surfaces regressions early. This PR introduces 'Onboard Chronicle', a lightweight generator that emits ephemeral patchnotes (human-friendly and machine-readable) during model onboarding, and a deterministic 'compat assertion' harness that runs a small canonical prompt set and computes a compatibility score against a baseline profile.

What this changes: adds a chronicle serializer and template-driven patchnote composer (registry/onboard/chronicle.py + release/templates/patchnote-template.hbs), a compat assertion runner (registry/onboard/compat_assertions.py) with 12 deterministic checks stored under registry/onboard/compat_baselines, and a tiny CLI wrapper (cli/registry-cli/patchnote.py) to preview or commit a generated patchnote to the model's release artifact. A signer utility (registry/onboard/signer.py) attaches a short provenance stamp so patchnotes can be traced to the onboarding run.

Checklist implemented: [x] serializer + template support for patchnotes [x] deterministic prompt set and scoring [x] CLI preview and commit mode [x] unit + integration tests for harness [x] CI workflow for compat gate (ci/workflows/compat.yml) [x] docs and quickstart.

Compatibility: The chronicle writer emits both JSONL for machine consumption and a compact markdown summary for human readers; it uses existing profile fields (profile.version, profile.affordances) so older tooling continues to work. The compat harness outputs a single scalar compatibility_score and a per-case delta list so downstream automation can implement policy thresholds.

Testing and CI: initial CI run (2026-01-20) failed integration due to nondeterministic RNG seed in a sample prompt; fixed by seeding the harness and adding a retry loop on transient tokenization differences. Subsequent runs passed all checks (unit + integration + lint). A scheduled nightly workflow was added to validate the maintainability of the deterministic prompt set.

Review notes and conversation: Marcus: "Nice separation of writer vs signer. Two asks: make the signer tolerant of missing KMS in private installs and add a small mock signer for unit tests." Response (Aisha): "Added a file-level mock signer and an env var KMS_EMBED_TOLERANCE; signer falls back to a local HMAC in private installs (README documents behaviour)." Jun: "Compat thresholds look reasonable; can we expose a per-linear-key override?" Response: "Exposed COMPAT_THRESHOLD env + Linear key-level override in config; docs updated." Elena: "Docs are good; one nit on the patchnote template wording." Response: "Updated wording and added examples in docs/quickstarts. Approved after fixes." 

Rollout plan: merged to main behind a feature flag ONBOARD_CHRONICLE. We will enable the flag for internal QA for two weeks, then flip for self-serve onboarding with a soft-warning mode (warnings do not block) for one month, then enable hard gating for enterprise onboarding flows. A migration step is provided: existing profiles will continue to produce chronicle outputs with fallback fields.

Risks and mitigations: false positives from the deterministic prompt set are the primary risk (model nondeterminism or tokenizer drift). Mitigations: nightly re-eval to surface drift, per-model threshold overrides, and a human-in-the-loop rollback for initial rollouts.

Merge result: squashed and merged on 2026-02-04 by Aisha Patel. Changelog: added to release notes under "Model registry: onboarding improvements" with brief usage example.

Related: ENG-4823 (compat automation), PM-77 (patchnote UX).
notes_for_maintainers:
- The compat harness stores baselines under registry/onboard/compat_baselines/<model_alias>/; keep the size small (we checked in a 12-case set per model).
- To add new cases, follow docs/onboard/chronicle.md and run scripts/onboard-hooks/generate_chronicle.sh to preview.
- Feature flag: ONBOARD_CHRONICLE; threshold env COMPAT_THRESHOLD defaults to 0.9.
- If you need to run locally without KMS, set KMS_EMBED_TOLERANCE=true to use local HMAC signer.
